title: Scenario-Based, Stormwater-Risk-Informed Screening of Spatially Optimized Permeable Pavement: Reproducibility Package for Seocho-gu, Seoul
description: Code, input data, and processed results reproducing the analyses in Kang, J. (2026), 'Scenario-Based, Stormwater-Risk-Informed Screening of Spatially Optimized Permeable Pavement: An Interpretable AI-Hydrology Framework for Seocho-gu, Seoul', Climate Risk Management (manuscript CLRM-D-26-00388). The package couples pySWMM-automated SWMM scenario generation with a physics-informed XGBoost surrogate, NSGA-II multi-objective spatial optimization, direct SWMM validation of Pareto solutions, SHAP-based spatial attribution, and multi-return-period / climate-stress sensitivity analysis.

creators.name: Kang, Junsuk
creators.affiliation: Department of Landscape Architecture and Rural Systems Engineering & Research Institute of Agriculture and Life Sciences, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
